text:
Lena: Quick note - nightly docs lint found 5 404 images and 4 orphan anchors across onboarding and runtime. Low priority but should be quick to tidy.

DocsBot: scan-id=scan-2409991111; findings: images=5 anchors=4; examples: /onboarding/quickstart -> /assets/quick-setup.png (404), /runtime/prefix-caching -> missing anchor #prefix-eviction.

Omar: I can pick the anchors tomorrow morning. I'll prefer to rename headers to match existing slugs instead of adding redirects. Will group them into one PR.

Priya: I can rehost the images; heads-up that CDN deploy is scheduled 09:30 UTC. Can we target merges after 10:30 UTC?

Lena: 10:30 UTC is fine. Omar please include rg output in the PR description. Example command I used: 

```
rg "quick-setup.png|prefix-eviction" content/ -n || true
```

Jules: tiny process note - if HTML comments for anchors are used, flag it in the PR body so our docs linter team doesn't auto-open follow-ups. I'll CR after 10:30 UTC.

Omar: Plan: PR 'docs/anchors/240999' with 3 header tweaks for runtime/prefix-caching.md, runtime/kv-cache.md, onboarding/quickstart.md. Mark WIP until Priya posts image branch.

Priya: pushed branch docs/images/rehost-240999 with path updates to /cdn.redwood.ai/docs/. Included staging screenshots and CORS headers in the S3 metadata.

DocsBot: follow-up scan scheduled in 12h. Reply 'ack' to snooze.

Jules: ack — will do CR once both PRs are ready. Omar/Priya please @mention me.

Lena: thanks team, will close the ticket after DocsBot's next scan. :party_face:
